name: zambezi-of-permits
description: Permits and inspections by job: permits expired or expiring, failed inspections with no re-inspection booked, inspections past their date with no result, inspections on permits you have no record of, and what is coming up. Writes a calendar file for permit expirations and inspections. Drafts notices to the project manager. Never applies to, renews with or schedules with a jurisdiction.
